item.title: Police respond to auto-ped crash in Mission
item.description: MISSION, Texas (ValleyCentral) — The Mission Police Department is investigating an auto-ped crash off Conway between 2 and 3 mile in Mission, according to a spokesperson from the Mission police. Police say crews are working at the scene. ValleyCentral is working to gather more details. This story will be updated as more details become available.
